messages:
Marta (CSM): quick heads-up — NimbusOne onboarding shows an unusual token burn pattern, want to sync before the QBR. Can we get a 30s forecast + a short list of asks for them? :eyes:
Emily (FinOps): on it. do we have the new onboarding job id? want to pull sequence length distribution first.
Raj (Finance): spotted the spike last night, looks correlated with two long chatflows they started testing. I can do a cost-forward if Emily can confirm avg seq len.
Marta (CSM): job id is `onboard-3824`. they ramped up to 25k calls/day yesterday. main ask: is this sustainable with their current commit?
Emily (FinOps): pulling samples now. preliminary numbers: avg seq ~820 tokens, tail at ~4200. will sketch a 7-day projection.
ops-bot: alert: budget-threshold (NimbusOne) crossed 80% of dev credits — triggered 2024-06-25 04:12 UTC. Auto-notify sent to CSM+FinOps.
Raj (Finance): ok here's a quick draft projection (per-day):
```
baseline (current commit): 120k tokens/day -> $144/day
observed ramp: 1.2M tokens/day -> $1,440/day
7-day projection if ramp holds: cumulative delta ~$9k
```
We should flag renewal risk if they continue at this rate w/out bump.
Josh (AE): I can reach out to the customer today to confirm planned volume. if they're experimenting, maybe propose a short-term burst add-on.
Marta (CSM): action items: Emily — finalize seq-length histogram + 7-day projection by EOD; Raj — prepare an "impact to runway" slide for QBR (1 slide); Josh — call customer and confirm experiment cadence; I'll capture enablement asks and feedback.
Emily (FinOps): copying quick sample approach for the slide so others can reuse: `top_pct = 0.95; median, p95, p99` then multiply by requests/day to get token burn bands.
Marta (CSM): also want to capture qualitative feedback — they said latency issues when cache warmed. please ask them about SDK/parallelism config on the call (might be easy fix).
Josh (AE): noted. I'll also ask if they'd consider a short commit bump for Dedicated or an interim credit top-up.
Raj (Finance): I can model three sensitivity tiers (conservative / expected / experiment). will drop the numbers in this thread when ready.
Emily (FinOps): uploaded draft histogram + table to the QBR folder: https://redwood.app/qbr/nimbusone — ping if access issues.
Marta (CSM): perfect. let's reconvene 2pm PT to review slides before the QBR. :thumbsup:
Josh (AE): 2pm works. I'll have customer availability after my call at 11am PT and update here.
Marta (CSM): thanks team. capturing this for the QBR notes and the renewal watchlist.
ops-bot: note: next budget alert threshold at 90% will auto-notify again.
